purpose: Measure local conditioning-versus-other-memory ablations in a separate process from frozen indexed Lean read inputs.
frames: The first frame after the automatic prompt plus four evenly spaced manifest indices from the prompt to the end, rounded and deduplicated; labels do not select frames. Sequence 3 is an engineering replay only.
capture: Replay the exact indexed Lean reference and only clone the existing memory-attention inputs and its outputs, SAM decoder inputs and outputs, and image dimensions at each predetermined frame. Store snapshots on the specified Google Drive output. Do not execute extra attention or decoder calls in the live video. Require saved trajectory masks, nonconditioning selections, indexed positions, memory events and model weights to match the indexed reference exactly.
offline: In a fresh process with the same author model, recompute indexed memory attention and SAM mask decoder on the snapshots. The unchanged snapshot must reproduce the captured attention and decoder tensors exactly and its output mask must match the original video mask. Then separately zero conditioning spatial memory content or other spatial memory content, preserving every token position, token count and pointer tail; decode each result and save masks. These discarded one-step counterfactuals never affect the video trajectory. No re-detection, confidence gate, new threshold or ground-truth input.
validation: Two independent label-free seq3 captures must reproduce each other and the reference trajectory. Two independent offline seq3 executions must reproduce every tensor and mask digest, including exact no-op output and unchanged pointer tail. Test capture and zeroing functions. Only then run the four selected videos and independently rescore snapshots and saved shadow masks against labels after prediction.
interpretation: Zero content keeps the positional keys and attention normalization; it is not identical to removing memory tokens. The shadow changes the current frame only, with the original reference history, and does not show full-video propagation performance. Videos are selected, previously inspected and annotations may be incomplete.
